propositions: bug_close_reason_ok has zero callers and both its consumers migrated to bug_close_class_ok, creating confusion risk for readers auditing close guards
The _attestation.py module is never invoked in production and is kept alive only by tests that call build_acli_client_from_env and reference the filename as a string
Three test files consume _attestation.py directly: test_attestation.py, test_config_jira_wiring.py, and test_backend_neutrality.py, all of which must be updated or deleted when the module is removed
Prose references to build_acli_client_from_env in _backend.py, adapters/jira/backend.py, and test_backend_neutrality.py must be corrected to avoid implying a live call site that no longer exists
The 0ac6 config routing assertions in test_config_jira_wiring.py can be re-pointed to JiraBackend.assert_env_ready() and resolve_jira_settings() without loss of intent
